2608.02353.title: Global Optimization and Inference-Time Region Grafting for Agentic Workflows
2608.02353.paper_summary: Recent advances in agentic workflow optimization automate workflow design through task-specific workflow search or input-conditioned architecture selection. However, they determine the workflow before execution and cannot adapt failed workflow regions using execution-time label-free quality signals. Naively enabling such inference-time adaptation through whole-workflow re-optimization would be computationally prohibitive. To tackle this challenge, we introduce GRAFT, which preserves a globally optimized workflow while locally replacing only selected regions for each input. Without parameter training, GRAFT evaluates region-level alternatives using label-free execution-quality signals and accepts only replacements that improve local quality while preserving workflow-level consistency, thereby enabling instance-wise adaptation without whole-workflow re-optimization. GRAFT applies without modification across a range of tasks spanning mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-hop and knowledge-intensive question answering. Under matched optimizer and executor settings, it improves over the strongest prior workflow-optimization method, MaAS, by 3.85 points on average. Replacing only the executor with a stronger model yields further gains without re-optimizing the global workflow. This suggests that an optimized workflow is not merely a static optimization artifact, but an adaptable execution policy that can evolve with inference-time feedback and stronger executors.
2608.02353.paper_summary_zh: 最近在代理工作流程優化方面的進展通過任務特定的工作流程搜索或輸入條件架構選擇自動化工作流程設計。<lb/>然而，它們在執行之前確定工作流程，並且無法使用執行時的無標籤質量信號來適應失敗的工作流程區域。<lb/>天真的通過整個工作流程的重新優化來啟用這種推斷時的適應將在計算上是不可行的。<lb/>為了解決這一挑戰，我們引入了GRAFT，它在保留全局優化工作流程的同時，僅針對每個輸入局部替換選定區域。<lb/>在不進行參數訓練的情況下，GRAFT使用無標籤的執行質量信號評估區域級別的替代方案，並僅接受那些在保留工作流程級別一致性的同時改善局部質量的替換，從而實現實例級的適應，而無需整個工作流程的重新優化。<lb/>GRAFT在數學推理、代碼生成以及多跳和知識密集型問題回答等多種任務中無需修改即可應用。<lb/>在匹配的優化器和執行器設置下，它在平均上比最強的先前工作流程優化方法MaAS提高了3.85分。<lb/>僅用更強的模型替換執行器而不重新優化全局工作流程會帶來進一步的增益。<lb/>這表明，優化的工作流程不僅僅是一種靜態的優化產物，而是一種可以隨著推斷時的反饋和更強的執行器而演變的可適應執行策略。
